name: Weird

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: creatures of your choice in the Sphere

summary: Chosen creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere make a Wis save: 10d10 Psychic and Frightened, or half damage only on a success.
text: A Frightened target makes a Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns, taking 5d10 Psychic damage on a failure; a success ends the spell on it.
